title: feat(app-shell): Clone to customize calls the permission-set clone door (objectui#7611, PR-4)
body:
Part of #7611
Clause-②: no

PR-4 of the objectui#7611 remainder (census item 4, the clone client), under the epic PM's answer-and-amendment 6111342697. Developer: a subagent of the epic PM, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01Rerax7QTjKMPCUZxQUtPFR`, `mode:subagent`. Draft on purpose: a dispatched PR stops at draft (objectui AGENTS.md section 9).

## What changes

- **"Clone to customize" calls the clone door.** On a permission set a code package ships, the button opens a dialog (`PermissionSetCloneDialog.tsx`, the shape of Setup's packaged-flow clone dialog) that asks for a new machine name and label. "Create copy" sends, through `permission-set-clone.ts`, `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/:name/clone` with exactly `{ name, label }` (objectstack#22881, the seat's ruling 6097763840 Q1 to A: "objectui calling it with a name and a label"). The door is server-only, so it is called the way `catalog-activation.ts` calls its door: `fetch` against `apiBase()`, the ADR-0112 envelope read by `actionErrorDetail`.
- **On success** the routed editor opens the copy in place, keeping the query string (a copy made in Setup opens in Setup, `?scope=environment`), and shows the server's notice as sent. An embedded host announces the copy by name with the same notice. An answer that names no copy is said so (`perm.clone.noName`), never guessed.
- **On a refusal** the dialog shows the server's message as sent and the editor stays on the set. The fallback string (`perm.clone.failedHttp`) is used only when the answer carries no message.
- **Removed:** `permission-set-clone-dispatch.ts`, the `sys_permission_set` row read, the `clone_permission_set` record-action dispatch, the editor's four `@object-ui/react` hooks that only served it, and the two strings only it used (`perm.clone.actionMissing`, `perm.clone.rowMissing`; nothing else read them).
- **Carried item (a), ACCEPT 6113300670:** Assigned users is not rendered for a set the server does not hold yet. The editor reads that off the layered envelope it already fetches: `MetadataClient.layered` answers a 404 as every layer null. A rejected read decides nothing (the section renders as before). The environment door's first successful Save under the page's name makes the set exist and the section appears.
- **Carried item (b):** the `cloneToCustomize` comment that said Assigned users "resolves the same set's record the same way" is gone with the function it sat in. The comment on the caller gate now names the clone door's own verdict (`metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`, `manage_metadata`) instead of the data door.
- **Texts my change made false:** the lock guidance, the clone hint, the artifact badge hint and the refused-save message said the copy is owned by your organization. The door saves it environment-wide with no organization, so they now say it is a permission set authored in this environment (en and zh). The hint no longer names the `clone_permission_set` action.

Not touched: `AssignedUsersSection.tsx` (objectui#12159 is in the merge queue), `CapabilityMultiSelectField`, `decisionOutputParams.ts`, anything in objectstack, any `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Decided by measurement

- **`carryOver` stays.** `ActionParamDialog`'s `carryOver` reader does not lose its producer here. On the showcase (objectstack `45e206e498`), `GET /api/v1/meta/object` serves exactly 5 `carryOver` params across 108 objects, all on `sys_permission_set`'s `clone_permission_set` (locations `list_item`, `record_header`). That action is still on the object page; this PR only stops the matrix editor from dispatching it. The reader implements the spec's `ActionParamSchema.carryOver`, which the spec's action form still offers authors, so it is not objectui-local dead code. It is left for objectstack stage 8's `ActionParamSchema.carryOver` retirement, as the census's carrier note says.
- **The `managedBy: platform` badge text is not a mechanical correction**, so it is not changed here. See the report's open question. Measured: the registry serves no `managedBy` on any of the showcase's 17 permission sets, no permission-set definition on objectstack main declares one, and the clone door drops it.

## Measured in a browser

objectstack `45e206e498` (contains #22881 and #22863), `examples/app-showcase` booted `--fresh`, this branch's console through Vite. Before cloning, the `sys_permission_set` rows of `showcase_field_ops_delegate` (it carries `adminScope`) and `showcase_member_default` (`isDefault: true`) were deleted in the database (the data door refuses deleting a packaged row: `success: false`). The registry still serves both sets.

- **This branch, as admin** (at `154949786`; the flow, the taken name and the malformed name re-measured at `5523d86e5` with copies named `field_ops_delegate_copy2` and `member_default_copy2`, same answers): Clone on `showcase_field_ops_delegate` sent one request, `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/showcase_field_ops_delegate/clone` with `{"name":"field_ops_delegate_copy","label":"Field Ops Delegate (copy)"}`, answered **200** (not 201; the door answers through the dispatcher's `success`, which is 200). The page moved to `/apps/setup/metadata/permission/field_ops_delegate_copy?scope=environment`: Save present and enabled, no Clone, the notice shown verbatim, Assigned users rendered, badge "Custom". No `sys_permission_set` request was made. Read back through `/api/v1/meta/permission/`: the copy has no `adminScope` (the source has), and `member_default_copy` has no `isDefault` (the source has `true`); neither copy carries `_packageId` or `_provenance`.
- **A taken name:** the same name again answered **409** `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`; the dialog stayed open and showed the server's message word for word, and the page stayed on the source.
- **A malformed name** (`Bad Name`): **400** `VALIDATION_FAILED`, the server's name-rule sentence shown in the dialog.
- **A non-holder:** the showcase's auditor persona granted `organization_admin` (capabilities `manage_org_users`, `setup.access`, `setup.write`, no `manage_metadata`) sees the set locked with no Clone and the stated reason ("requires the `manage_metadata` capability"). The door itself, called as that user, answers **403** `PERMISSION_DENIED` "Saving a metadata item requires the `manage_metadata` capability."; unauthenticated, **401**.
- **An unsaved set** (`/apps/setup/metadata/permission/never_saved_branch?scope=environment`): no Assigned users section and no Add; after the first Save the section renders.
- **Base, same server and state** (the two source files temporarily set to `c0c2f792b`, then restored and proven equal to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty): Clone on `showcase_field_ops_delegate` read `GET /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set?...name=...` (0 records) and refused "Clone is unavailable: no sys_permission_set record named showcase_field_ops_delegate was found." An unsaved set rendered Assigned users with Add.

## Tests

Final head `5523d86e5`. The second commit only moves `clonePermissionSet` out of the dialog file, unchanged (`react-refresh/only-export-components` flagged a function exported beside a component), and edits two comments.

- `PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize.test.tsx` rewritten around the door (fetch stubbed with the door's measured answers) and `PermissionMatrixEditor.setupCatalog-7611.test.tsx` extended: 28 tests pass.
- app-shell's whole suite at `154949786` (the first commit): 1272 files passed and 1 skipped; 12344 tests passed and 9 skipped. At `5523d86e5`: every `PermissionMatrixEditor*` suite, `permission-slice*`, and the three `packages/i18n` tests that read this i18n table, 26 files and 193 tests passed; the same three plus `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts` also passed at the first commit.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) after `turbo build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`: exit 0 at both commits; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both changed suites and both new modules.
- Gates, each exit 0: changeset presence, no-major, fixed, overwrite, claims, pending-changeset-literals; `check:new-line-citations` (0 new); `check:control-bytes`; `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`; `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `-inherit`, `-override-shape`; `check:test-path-roots`; `check:unreferenced-sources`; `check:metadata-write-doors`; `check:handler-key-reads`; `check-type-check-coverage`. `check:i18n-dead-keys` is report-only and names none of this PR's keys. `check:eager-closure` exit 0 against a local `vite build` of the console (the gate reads the built report; this module is in the eager closure). ESLint (root config, `--no-inline-config`) on the six changed TypeScript files: 0 errors; per file, no rule fires more often than at the base (no type-aware linting is configured, so untouched files cannot move). Re-run at `5523d86e5`: every gate above, exit 0.

**Ablations**, one per new pin, each from a committed state (`154949786`; A1, A5, A7 and A8 again at `5523d86e5` against the moved code, same red) through `ablation-replace` (anchor must hit once, blob must change; restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`), each run of the two suites turning exactly the named pin(s) red:

| Leg | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | the door body gains a third key | POSTs exactly name and label |
| A2 | the hop drops the query string | the copy opens in the same scope |
| A3 | the notice paragraph removed | the copy shows the notice; the embedded announcement |
| A4 | the embedded "Cloned as" line removed | the embedded announcement |
| A5 | Cancel submits | a cancelled dialog sends nothing |
| A6 | the no-name guard disabled | an answer that names no copy |
| A7 | the server's message replaced by the fallback | 409 and 403 shown as sent |
| A8 | the fallback replaced | a refusal with no message names the status |
| A9 | the caller gate dropped from the clone condition | a caller without manage_metadata is offered no clone |
| A10 | the existence term dropped from the Assigned users gate | an unsaved set lists no holders |
| A11 | the post-save existence write removed | the first Save makes the holders render |
| A12 | a failed read counted as not found | control: a failed read decides nothing |

A10's first attempt was refused by the tool before any run (the replacement `;` already occurred in the file, so its count could not rise); it was re-run with a distinct anchor and is the reading above.

## Acceptance notes

- The door answers **200** for a created copy; the dispatch expected 201. The client accepts any 2xx with an unrefused envelope. Observation only: no contract I found declares 201 for this door (its changeset says nothing of the status). Not filed.
- The copies are also written as `sys_permission_set` rows (15 rows before, 17 after the two clones): the server's write-through until stage 8, not this client's doing.
- The previous hop to a clone dropped the query string, so a clone made in Setup opened outside the Setup catalog. The rewritten hop keeps it (pinned by A2's test).
